About

Graphic designer and visual content creator. Since mid-2026 I have been Content Specialist at Tehran Institute of Technology (Ekbatan branch), designing course posters and environmental banners, shooting and editing reels, and writing captions around the customer.

Before that I was Content Specialist at Barium, and I designed the logo and website banners for Ravin Mobile Store as project work. I combine hand-made design with AI-assisted visuals, and my long-term goal is art direction and visual content in image and video.

Alongside design, I also work in theater, and my stage credits are on Tiwall.
